{{Top|leg}}
'''Fotakex''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Fotakex added comments to the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] entry in the Datalog, detailing some of its history and how [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] eventually discontinued the line. Fotakex also commented on the [[Espo grenade mortar]], [[PLX-4 Missile Launcher]], and [[Apex Incisor Missile]] entries.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
